headline: Inventory Controller
summary: Former administrative assistant who moved into inventory control at a hardware and home-improvement retailer in Cavite. Three years handling the office's records and paperwork gave me a strong eye for detail; for the past year I have kept store and warehouse inventory records accurate and reconciled counts with the system.

experience.title: Inventory Controller
bullets: Keep inventory records for about 8,000 items across the store and back room.
Run cycle counts and reconcile differences with receiving and sales records.
Verify supplier delivery receipts against purchase orders before posting.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Handled filing, correspondence and office supplies for the store manager.
Prepared reports and memos in Word and Excel.
Organised the store's permits, contracts and supplier files.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
